Fin Fang Foom.subject: International Relations
Fin Fang Foom.question: He initially serves the _____ before eventually betraying him to reunite with his fellow dragons
Fin Fang Foom.fact: He initially serves the Mandarin before eventually betraying him to reunite with his fellow dragons. This version was created by the original Mandarin to guard one of his Makluan rings and test potential successors.
